title: Design System: AWS MLOps Reference Platform

headline.purpose: Names the platform inside the CRT shell.

headline-compact.purpose: Replaces the headline on a short viewport, so the first frame ends above the fold.

masthead.purpose: Carries the engineer's name in the header and footer.

title.purpose: Names a story column or an evidence panel.

label.purpose: Marks terminal keys, readout keys, and evidence tabs.

node.purpose: Names an architecture stage and the submit command.

control.purpose: Names a trace, a disclosure summary, and the skip link.

data.purpose: Carries readouts, input values, and summaries.

detail.purpose: Carries tables, proof copy, and trace detail.

meta.purpose: Marks uppercase field labels and unit names.

micro.purpose: Carries the route line and code blocks. The legibility floor.

fonts.purpose: The display voice. Every heading, control label, and node name.

fonts.stack: SFMono-Regular, Cascadia Code, Liberation Mono, ui-monospace, monospace
fonts.purpose: Body text and data. Never self-hosted.

shadows.name: page-bloom
shadows.purpose: Lights the page field from its own edges, behind every section.

shadows.name: shell-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the CRT shell from the page field. The one real cast shadow.

shadows.name: shell-inner-bloom
shadows.purpose: Lights the inside of the CRT shell; an inset 1.25rem edge repeats it.

shadows.name: console-depth
shadows.purpose: Sets the prediction console apart from the page at lower strength.

shadows.name: control-press
shadows.purpose: Marks an active stage node or terminal key.

shadows.name: route-glow
shadows.purpose: Lights a route that belongs to the selected trace.

shadows.name: cursor-glow
shadows.purpose: Lights the evidence pulse and the node it lands on.

shadows.name: rail-edge
shadows.purpose: Marks the selected evidence tab; becomes a top edge when the rail stacks.

shadows.name: footer-edge
shadows.purpose: Closes the page on the same emissive edge the hero opened with.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Colour change on links, presets, and contact rows.

motion.name: state-control
motion.purpose: Border, fill, and shadow change on keys, fields, and the command button.

motion.name: state-node
motion.purpose: Border, fill, and bracket opacity change on nodes, tabs, and ledger rows.

motion.name: evidence-signal
motion.purpose: The one bright pulse along the evidence cursor. Runs once, settles at 0.4 opacity.

motion.name: evidence-resolve
motion.purpose: Wipes the proof readout in from the left as the lens changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

layout.measure: 40ch to 70ch for body copy, 62ch for standfirsts

components.name: Terminal Key
components.description: The rectangular action key that closes the first viewport.
components.html: Read the source
components.css: .ds-terminal-key { position: relative; display: inline-flex; gap: 0.8rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.7rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--faint, #264a20); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel, #061007); color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); font-family: "VT323", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-terminal-key svg { width: 1.3rem; height: 1.3rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-terminal-key::before, .ds-terminal-key::after { position: absolute; width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; content: ""; opacity: 0.55; transition: opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-terminal-key::before { top: 0.25rem; left: 0.25rem; border-top: 1px solid currentColor; border-left: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-terminal-key::after { right: 0.25rem; bottom: 0.25rem; border-right: 1px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-terminal-key:hover { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); background: var(--action-active, #0a1c0c); color: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.36), inset 0 0 1.1rem rgba(141,255,77,0.07); } .ds-terminal-key:hover::before, .ds-terminal-key:hover::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-terminal-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Command Button
components.description: The one filled control on the page. Submits the prediction.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: One feature cell in the prediction grid. The cell rules itself with borders.

components.description: One lifecycle stage. Resting, on-trace, and selected are three distinct states.

border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel, #061007); color: var(--text, #bafc8c); cursor: pointer; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", ui-monospace, monospace; transition: color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stage-service { margin-top: 0.22rem; color: var(--text-faint, #6d9f5c); font-size: 0.73rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-stage-node::before, .ds-stage-node::after { position: absolute; width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; content: ""; opacity: 0.55; transition: opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-stage-node::before { top: 0.25rem; left: 0.25rem; border-top: 1px solid currentColor; border-left: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-stage-node::after { right: 0.25rem; bottom: 0.25rem; border-right: 1px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-stage-node:hover { border-color: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); background: var(--panel-strong, #09180b); color: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); } .ds-stage-node:hover::before, .ds-stage-node:hover::after, .ds-stage-node.is-active::before, .ds-stage-node.is-active::after { opacity: 1; components.name: Evidence Tab
components.description: One proof lens on the evidence rail. The evidence cursor lands on the selected tab.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr); max-width: 13rem; border: 1px solid var(--faint, #264a20); } .ds-evidence-tab { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; padding: 1rem 0.85rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--dim, #5ca83c); cursor: pointer; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; transition: color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-evidence-tab + .ds-evidence-tab { border-top: 1px solid var(--faint, #264a20); } .ds-evidence-ring { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 3.4rem; height: 3.4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0.75; transition: opacity 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-evidence-tab svg { width: 1.7rem; height: 1.7rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.3; } .ds-evidence-tab > span:last-of-type, .ds-evidence-tab > span:not(.ds-evidence-ring) { margin-top: 0.45rem; font-family: "VT323", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-evidence-tab small { max-width: 20ch; margin-top: 0.3rem; color: var(--text-faint, #6d9f5c); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-evidence-tab:hover { color: var(--text-muted, #9cd087); background: rgba(141,255,77,0.07); } .ds-evidence-tab.is-active { color: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); background: rgba(141,255,77,0.11); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); } .ds-evidence-tab.is-active .ds-evidence-ring { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141,255,77,0.07); } .ds-evidence-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Trace Ledger Row
components.description: One trace path, showing the platform's real AWS component chain.
components.css: .ds-trace-control { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(9rem, 0.28fr) 1fr; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 0.38rem 0.35rem; border: 0; background: rgba(141,255,77,0.11); color: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); cursor: pointer; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: left; transition: color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-trace-control:hover { color: var(--text-muted, #9cd087); background: rgba(141,255,77,0.07); } .ds-trace-name { display: flex; gap: 0.55rem; align-items: center; font-family: "VT323", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-trace-name svg { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-width: 2.4; } .ds-trace-chain { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 0.55rem; align-items: center; min-width: 0; } .ds-trace-hop { position: relative; padding: 0.1rem 0.42rem; border: 1px solid var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); color: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-trace-hop + .ds-trace-hop { margin-left: 0.75rem; } .ds-trace-hop + .ds-trace-hop::before { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: -0.95rem; width: 0.7rem; height: 1px; background: var(--dim, #5ca83c); content: ""; } .ds-trace-hop + .ds-trace-hop::after { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: -0.36rem; width: 0.22rem; height: 0.22rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--dim, #5ca83c); border-right: 1px solid var(--dim, #5ca83c); content: ""; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-trace-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bright, #d3ffb9); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Evidence Cursor
components.description: The signature moment. A halo, a dashed line, one pulse, and a lit landing node.
components.html: <svg class="ds-route-layer" viewBox="0 0 320 90" width="320" height="90" aria-hidden="true"><path class="ds-evidence-halo" d="M20 70 V20 H280 V45 H300"/><path class="ds-evidence-line" d="M20 70 V20 H280 V45 H300"/><path class="ds-evidence-pulse" d="M20 70 V20 H280 V45 H300"/><circle class="ds-evidence-node-glow" cx="300" cy="45" r="9"/><circle class="ds-evidence-node" cx="300" cy="45" r="4"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-route-layer { overflow: visible; background: var(--ink, #020603); } .ds-evidence-halo { fill: none; stroke: var(--dim, #5ca83c); stroke-width: 8; opacity: 0.28; filter: blur(5px); } .ds-evidence-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 7 5; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(141,255,77,0.7)); } .ds-evidence-pulse { fill: none; stroke: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-dasharray: 14 600; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(141,255,77,0.9)); animation: ds-evidence-signal 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-evidence-node { fill: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); stroke: var(--bright, #d3ffb9); stroke-width: 1.5; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(141,255,77,0.9)); } .ds-evidence-node-glow { fill: var(--phosphor, #8dff4d); opacity: 0.22; filter: blur(4px); } @keyframes ds-evidence-signal { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 400; opacity: 0; } 18% { opacity: 1; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 0.4; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-evidence-pulse { animation-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The page reads as one instrument, not as a document about an instrument. A near-black field carries a single green signal family. A curved CRT shell holds the lifecycle schematic, and the same material continues below the shell as a page-wide scanline and a soft radial bloom. The visitor never crosses from a themed hero into plain text on black.

Brightness carries the state. Structure sits at the faint step, dormant parts at the dim step, active parts at the phosphor step, and the current selection or readout at the bright step. Nothing changes hue to say it is selected. The one exception is the warm fault pair, which appears only when something failed.

Density is deliberate. Inside the schematic the rhythm is tight, because the argument is that the parts connect. Between page sections the rhythm is generous, because each section is a separate claim. Routes are measured, not approximated: connectors read real element geometry and land on ports at the node edges.
keyCharacteristics: One green signal family over near-black, with brightness as the state channel.
A page-wide scanline and radial bloom that keep every section the same material.
Measured routes with arrowheads and edge ports, drawn from real geometry.
An evidence cursor that runs from the selected stage to its proof lens.
Bitmap display type against a system monospace stack for body and data.
Flat frames with hairline rules; depth belongs to the shell.

rules.name: The Single Declaration Rule
rules.body: Every colour MUST be declared once in :root. A literal colour anywhere else in the stylesheet is drift.

rules.name: The Brightness State Rule
rules.body: State MUST travel on brightness. Faint is structure, dim is dormant, phosphor is active, and bright is the current selection or readout.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Bright phosphor MUST identify a current action, selection, focus target, or primary readout.

rules.name: The Fault Isolation Rule
rules.body: The warm fault pair MUST appear only in a real failure.

rules.name: The Dormant Is Not A Fault Rule
rules.body: A part that is off by choice MUST read as structure. It uses a dashed rule and the faint text step. A cold inference endpoint and an unset profile link both use this state, not the fault pair.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Display text and controls MUST use VT323. Body text and data MUST use the system monospace stack. This rule is load-bearing: a reviewer proposed one voice, and the build kept two.

rules.name: The Text Ramp Rule
rules.body: Reading text MUST take its colour from the four-step text ramp. A new green for a new paragraph is drift.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Text MUST NOT render below about 11.5px. The micro step is the floor.

rules.name: The Above The Fold Rule
rules.body: The first viewport MUST end above the fold at 1280x720 and taller. Short viewports MUST tighten the hero rather than drop a part of it.

rules.name: The Mobile Carries The Architecture Rule
rules.body: The stacked layout MUST keep the routes drawn. Hiding them removes the page's whole argument.

rules.name: The Shell Depth Rule
rules.body: The CRT shell MUST own the strongest ambient shadow. Internal frames MUST use borders at rest.

rules.name: The Page Material Rule
rules.body: The scanline and the bloom MUST run the whole page. A section that drops them becomes plain text on black and leaves the world.

rules.name: The Two Corner Rule
rules.body: A corner bracket MUST use two opposing corners, and it MUST brighten with state. Four corners add no information, and a bracket that never changes is decoration.

rules.name: The Square By Default Rule
rules.body: A new frame MUST be square. Radius is reserved for controls and for the shell.

rules.name: The Measured Route Rule
rules.body: A route MUST be drawn from measured geometry. Percentage coordinates cannot land on a node whose grid gap and font metrics change at runtime.

rules.name: The Real Chain Rule
rules.body: The ledger MUST render the platform's real component chain. A decorative track that looks like instrumentation is a defect.

dos: Do declare every new colour once in :root, and reference it by variable.
Do carry state on brightness: faint for structure, dim for dormant, phosphor for active, bright for the current selection.
Do keep the two type voices: VT323 for display and controls, system monospace for body and data.
Do draw a connector from measured element geometry, with an arrowhead and ports at both ends.
Do keep the scanline and the bloom under every section, so the lower page stays the same material as the hero.
Do give a part that is off by choice the dashed dormant treatment and an explanation of the cost decision.
Do resolve every animation to a static path under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't write a literal colour value below the :root block.
Don't use the warm fault pair for anything but a real failure.
Don't round a structural frame. Radius belongs to controls and to the shell.
Don't draw four corner brackets, and don't leave a bracket that never changes with state.
Don't hide the routes at a small width. The stacked page still MUST carry the architecture.
Don't show an active state with glow alone. A border, a route, or a label MUST carry it too.
Don't place semantic evidence inside a raster image.
Don't state a metric, a timestamp, or a completion claim the platform does not measure.
